name: Resizable Newsgroups Pane
changes: Adds a draggable Newsgroups/Articles splitter so the Newsgroups name column can be widened or narrowed manually.
Persists the presentation-only Newsgroups pane width locally and restores it across launches.
Clamps the pane width responsively to preserve usable Articles and Related Media space.
Adds keyboard resizing, double-click reset, and full-name hover tooltips for truncated newsgroup names.
regression_guards: The v3.7.5 Related Media grouping classifier and stable article-key promotion remain unchanged and keep their behavioral regression test.
Newsgroup loading, search, sorting, bookmarks, Recent history, tabs, and article browsing behavior remain unchanged.
Private SABnzbd 5.1.2 and SABCTools 9.6.3 provenance remain unchanged.
The managed About & Updates Setup lifecycle remains unchanged.
preserved: NNTP connection/concurrency behavior, thumbnail scheduling, gallery virtualization, Direct Unpack/post-processing and PAR2/repair.
Automation, Smart Import, Backup & Restore and all twelve themes.
Metadata Server 0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector 1.0.31 remain separate unchanged components.
